QUESTION Question 16: Final Challenge: Help a Friend

No clues! Find a different place for each problem.

  • “My landlord says I must leave my apartment.”
  • “I need a new passport from my country.”
  • “I want to talk to a job counselor.”
  • “I need free food this week.”
16

ANSWER Question 16: Help a Friend

Many answers are OK! Here are some.

  • “My landlord says I must leave.” → HousingCity Life/Vida Urbana · Office of Housing Stability · Maverick Landing · or Legal Help: Court Forms Online
  • “I need a new passport.” → ConsulatesFind your country: Mexico, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Haiti, Peru, Cape Verde
  • “I want a job counselor.” → Job HelpMassHire (Chelsea) · JVS Boston · AACA
  • “I need free food this week.” → FoodEast Boston Soup Kitchen · YMCA Grocery Bags · Central Community Church · Our Daily Bread · BCYF Paris Street
